description.value: A voxel-based morphometry study examined cerebellar grey matter volume differences associated with smoking in heavy smokers and never-smokers.

spans.text: The purpose of the present study was to make use of the Spatially Unbiased Infratentorial (SUIT) toolbox (Diedrichsen 2006 ) in the context of VBM in order to provide an optimized exploration of the structural alterations associated with smoking focussing on the human cerebellum.
